scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && ./scripts/wait-for-pg.sh && atlas migrate apply --env local --url "${DATABASE_URL:-postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres}?sslmode=disable"
scripts.lint:pending-migrations: atlas migrate diff check_sync --env local 2>&1 | grep -q 'no changes' || (echo '❌ Pending migrations detected. Please apply or remove them.' && exit 1)
scripts.test: pnpm run test:setup && pnpm run test:lint && pnpm run test:run
scripts.prod-db-connect: docker rm -f cloud-sql-proxy 2>/dev/null; docker run -d --name cloud-sql-proxy -p 127.0.0.1:5433:5432 -v ~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json:/config/adc.json -e GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/config/adc.json gcr.io/cloud-sql-connectors/cloud-sql-proxy:latest --address 0.0.0.0 plot-core:northamerica-northeast2:plot-prod
